title: JSON and CSV data

spans.text: JSON suits nested objects; CSV suits tabular data. The json and csv modules are in the standard library; validate the format and size before processing user files.

spans.code:
import json

payload = {'active': True, 'count': 3}
text = json.dumps(payload)
restored = json.loads(text)
No console output; restored is {'active': True, 'count': 3}.

spans.text: json.loads converts JSON text into Python values.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: JSON uses true, false, and null rather than Python's True, False, and None.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
